This allows the RL agent to reason about both low-level syntactic changes and high-level semantic implications. The policy network, implemented as a graph attention network (GAT), operates directly on the joint representation space, modeling dependencies on the code structure. The authors present a comprehensive experimental evaluation, demonstrating that their method outperforms existing approaches in terms of refactoring quality and generalization capability. Specifically, the method shows promising results in maintaining performance when transferred to different programming languages without fine-tuning, suggesting strong generalization ability. The authors also incorporate differential testing to ensure semantic preservation during refactoring.
